description EN:

It's a solar clock driven installation, designed for Boom Festival, that starts at sunset and ends at sunrise, with generative geometry controlling 6 robotic beams, standing on top of 6 neo-megalithic structures made by atelier Rethorica with bio construction techniques.

Every hour, and every half hour, the interactive mode activates for 10 minutes, and the boomers can control the lights with their bodies.

During the first half hour the installation is focused on Earth light patterns, projected on the ground. During the second half hour, the focus is the night sky, using lines to draw Sacred Geometry in the starred canvas.

descriptions.content:
It is a solar-clock-driven installation designed for Boom Festival, starting at sunset and ending at sunrise, with generative geometry controlling 6 robotic beams placed on top of 6 neo-megalithic structures built by atelier Rethorica using bio-construction techniques.

Every hour and every half hour, the interactive mode activates for 10 minutes, allowing participants to control the lights with their bodies.

During the first half hour, the installation focuses on earthbound light patterns projected onto the ground. During the second half hour, the focus shifts to the night sky, using lines to draw sacred geometry across the starlit canopy.

É uma instalação guiada por um relógio solar, concebida para o Boom Festival, que começa ao pôr-do-sol e termina ao nascer do sol, com geometria generativa a controlar 6 feixes robóticos colocados no topo de 6 estruturas neo-megalíticas construídas pelo atelier Rethorica com técnicas de bioconstrução.

A cada hora e a cada meia hora, o modo interactivo activa-se durante 10 minutos, permitindo aos participantes controlar as luzes com o corpo.

Durante a primeira meia hora, a instalação concentra-se em padrões de luz terrestres projectados no chão. Durante a segunda meia hora, o foco desloca-se para o céu nocturno, usando linhas para desenhar geometria sagrada na abóbada estrelada.
